findings.current: For over three hundred years, the sect had gone around setting fires across the land.
findings.defect: Omits that the sect set fires across the land generation after generation.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 대대로, explicitly describing the practice as continuing through successive generations.
findings.replacement: For over three hundred years, generation after generation, the sect had gone around setting fires across the land.

findings.current: I’d just made such a huge, spectacular mess all by myself.
findings.defect: Softens the source’s explicit profanity and blunts the crude joke.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly says 똥 (shit) and describes it as 크고 아름답다 (big and beautiful); “mess” removes the profanity and “spectacular” changes the joke’s wording.
findings.replacement: I’d just left such a huge, beautiful pile of shit all by myself.

findings.current: He’d regained his youth and vigor through Bone Transformation.
findings.defect: “Vigor” loses the source’s reference to regained sharpness or keen intelligence.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 과거의 젊음과 총기, referring to his former youth and sharpness.
findings.replacement: He’d regained his youth and sharpness through Bone Transformation.

summary: Three minor fidelity issues: an omitted continuity detail, softened profanity, and a loss of the source’s reference to Jeok Cheongang’s sharpness.
